cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial Account Open screen renders on transaction start
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. From the Main Menu select Account Open (transaction OROA)
2. Observe the screen presented
cases.expected: The Account Open screen is shown: header line 『Tran:』『OROA』 · 『Pgm :』『OCACCTA』 · title 『ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM』 · current 『Date:』 and 『Time:』; six labelled entry fields 『Account ID:』『Cust ID   :』『Credit Lim:』『Cash Lim  :』『Open Date :』『Group ID  :』, all empty; the message line shows 『Enter new account details and press ENTER.』; the bottom legend shows 『ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear』.
cases.remark: AST 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND MAP MACCTAA ERASE L185) · WS-M-PROMPT L100 · header 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · BMS MACCTAA / SDD-MAP-001 · UC-Account-Open

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Entry fields start empty with the cursor on Account ID
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account Open screen (transaction OROA)
2. Check the initial field contents and cursor position
cases.expected: All six entry fields (Account ID, Cust ID, Credit Lim, Cash Lim, Open Date, Group ID) are blank and the cursor rests on the Account ID field ready for input.
cases.remark: AST 1000-SEND-INITIAL: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MACCTAAO L174, MOVE -1 TO ACCTIDL L177 (cursor) · item-states §2 (○ at entry)

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Open Date left blank defaults to today's date
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000123 exists; account 00000004567 does not yet exist. *(needs real data — confirm an existing customer id)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account ID = 4567
2. Enter Cust ID = 123
3. Enter Credit Lim = 5,000.00
4. Enter Cash Lim = 1,000.00
5. Leave Open Date blank
6. Enter Group ID = DEFAULT01
7. Press ENTER
cases.data: Account ID=4567; Cust ID=123; Credit Lim=5,000.00; Cash Lim=1,000.00; Open Date=(blank); Group ID=DEFAULT01
cases.expected: The date utility supplies today's date (2026-09-28) as the open date, the account is created with that open date, and the message line shows 『Account opened successfully.』
cases.remark: AST 5060-VAL-OPEN blank branch: MOVE 'TODY' TO KD-FUNC, CALL OUDATE, MOVE KD-DATE-OUT TO WS-NEW-OPEN L433 · AC-OPEN-DATE

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Header shows current date and time in the expected format
cases.precondition: F-STD. System date/time is 2026-09-28, 14:30:00.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account Open screen (transaction OROA)
2. Read the Date and Time header fields
cases.expected: The Date header shows the current date in year-month-day form separated by hyphens (2026-09-28) and the Time header shows the current time separated by colons (14:30:00).
cases.remark: AST 8500-GET-DATE-TIME: EXEC CICS ASKTIME + FORMATTIME YYYYMMDD DATESEP('-') TIME TIMESEP(':') L608-616 · WS-HDR-DATE/WS-HDR-TIME

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Open a new account end-to-end (main success flow)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000123 exists; account 00000004567 does not yet exist. *(needs real data — confirm an existing customer id)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account ID = 4567
2. Enter Cust ID = 123
3. Enter Credit Lim = 5,000.00
4. Enter Cash Lim = 1,000.00
5. Enter Open Date = 2026-09-28
6. Enter Group ID = DEFAULT01
7. Press ENTER
cases.data: Account ID=4567; Cust ID=123; Credit Lim=5,000.00; Cash Lim=1,000.00; Open Date=2026-09-28; Group ID=DEFAULT01
cases.expected: All six fields pass validation; a new account 00000004567 is created in the account master and a matching card cross-reference record is created; the screen is cleared for the next entry and the message line shows 『Account opened successfully.』
cases.remark: AST 2100-OPEN-ACCT → 5000-VALIDATE-ALL → 3500-WRITE-ACCT (WRITE WS-ACCTFILE L296) → 3700-WRITE-XREF (WRITE WS-XREFFILE L321) → WS-M-OK L120

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Credit limit with thousands separators and two decimals is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000123 exists; account 00000004567 free. *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account ID = 4567, Cust ID = 123
2. Enter Credit Lim = 1,234,567.89
3. Enter Cash Lim = 1,000.00
4. Enter Open Date = 2026-09-28, Group ID = DEFAULT01
5. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The commas are ignored during parsing and the credit limit is stored as 1234567.89; the account is created and the message line shows 『Account opened successfully.』
cases.remark: AST 5100-PARSE-AMOUNT: WHEN ',' CONTINUE L499-500, digit accumulation 5150 · AC-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Amount with a single decimal digit is scaled to two decimals

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected

cases.name: Pseudo-conversational routing: first entry displays, next ENTER processes
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction OROA fresh (no prior conversation state)
2. Observe the initial display
3. Key any value and press ENTER
cases.expected: On the first invocation the blank form is displayed and the conversation is marked as re-entry; the subsequent ENTER is routed to input processing rather than redisplaying the blank form.
cases.remark: AST 0000-MAIN: IF EIBCALEN = 0 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL; ELSE EVALUATE CA-FIRST-ENTER vs OTHER → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT L157-166 · CA-PGM-CONTEXT set to 1 L186

cases.name: After a successful create the form is ready for the next account
cases.precondition: F-STD. A valid new account has just been submitted (see IT_ACCTOPEN_HAPPY_005).
cases.steps:
1. Complete a successful account creation
2. Observe the screen state afterwards
cases.expected: The screen is reset to a blank form with the message line showing 『Account opened successfully.』, so the operator can immediately key another new account without re-navigating.
cases.remark: AST 2100 success path → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L225 then MOVE WS-M-OK TO ERRMSGO L226 + 8100-SEND-DATAONLY · item-states □ after confirm-create

cases.name: Account master record content on create

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Date-utility subroutine is invoked for open-date handling
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000123 exists; account 00000004567 free. *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Case A: leave Open Date blank and press ENTER
2. Case B: enter Open Date = 2026-09-28 and press ENTER
cases.expected: The program calls the date-utility subroutine: for the blank date it requests today's date and receives 2026-09-28; for the supplied date it requests a format check and receives a success status, so the account is opened using the utility's result in both cases.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Account file write failure is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD. The account master responds with an I/O error on write (e.g. file closed/disabled). *(needs real data — environment fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter a fully valid new account
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Valid account values; account master write returns a non-normal, non-duplicate response
cases.expected: The account is not created and the message line shows 『Error writing the account file.』
cases.remark: AST 3500-WRITE-ACCT EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → WS-M-WRITE-ERR L302-303 · WS-M-WRITE-ERR L122

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Unrecoverable file error on lookup aborts the transaction

cases.steps:

2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Customer/account read returns an abnormal file response
cases.expected: The transaction aborts: a full-screen text 『OCACCTA: unrecoverable file error. Contact support.』 is shown and the transaction ends.
cases.remark: AST 3000/3100 EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → 9500-ABEND-RTN (SEND TEXT L638, RETURN L641) · WS-MSG-TEXT

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-submitting the same account id does not create a duplicate
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000004567 has just been created successfully (see IT_ACCTOPEN_HAPPY_005).
cases.steps:
1. Key account id 4567 again with valid values
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Account ID=4567 (created in the previous run)
cases.expected: The second attempt is rejected with 『Account id already exists.』 and no second account record is created — the operation is idempotent on the account key.
cases.remark: AST 5090-VAL-ACCT-UNIQUE REC-FOUND · WS-M-ACCT-DUP · idempotency via uniqueness re-check

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Cross-reference write failure leaves account created but reports success (latent gap)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The cross-reference file responds with an I/O error on write while the account write succeeds. *(needs real data — environment fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter a fully valid new account
2. Press ENTER (account write succeeds, cross-reference write faults)
cases.data: Valid account values; cross-reference write returns a non-normal, non-duplicate response
cases.expected: The account IS created but the cross-reference is missing; per the source the cross-ref error 『Account written; cross-ref write failed.』 is set and then overwritten by the re-init prompt and the success message, so the operator actually sees 『Account opened successfully.』 — an integrity discrepancy to flag (the cross-reference error is never surfaced).
cases.remark: AST 3700-WRITE-XREF WHEN OTHER → WS-M-XREF-ERR L328, then overwritten at 1000-SEND-INITIAL L225 (WS-M-PROMPT) + WS-M-OK L226 · latent defect · WS-M-XREF-ERR L124

cases.mid: 排他・同時実行 (Exclusion / concurrent access)
cases.name: Concurrent insert of the same account id is caught on write
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000004567 is absent at the uniqueness check but another task inserts it before this task writes. *(needs real data — concurrency timing)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter a valid new account 4567 that passes the uniqueness check
2. Before the write completes, a concurrent task creates account 00000004567
3. This task performs its write
cases.data: Account ID=4567 (inserted concurrently by another task)
cases.expected: The account write returns a duplicate response and the message line shows 『Account id already exists.』; no duplicate record is created.
cases.remark: AST 3500-WRITE-ACCT EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN DFHRESP(DUPREC) → WS-M-ACCT-DUP L300-301 · distinct trigger point from 5090 (write-time race)

cases.name: Correct a rejected field and resubmit successfully
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000123 exists; account 00000004567 free. *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Account ID = 4567, Cust ID = 123, Credit Lim = 1,000.00
2. Enter Cash Lim = 2,000.00 (too high), Open Date = 2026-09-28, Group ID = DEFAULT01
3. Press ENTER (rejected)
4. Change Cash Lim to 800.00 on the retained screen
5. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The first submit is rejected with 『Cash limit cannot exceed credit limit.』 and the keyed values remain on the screen; after lowering the cash limit the account is created and the message line shows 『Account opened successfully.』
cases.remark: AST 2100 WS-INVALID → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY (keeps map fields) L217-219; corrected re-entry passes 5000-VALIDATE-ALL · WS-M-CS-GT-CR then WS-M-OK
